functions.name: get_basket_decision
functions.description: Call the same self-hosted Laya decision model used locally for an ambiguous shelf event. Returns candidate, option probabilities and model identity; never changes a cart.

eventId.description: Source event ID of the ambiguous case.

functions.name: get_shelf_event
functions.description: Read the immutable shelf event that opened a case.

eventId.description: Shelf event ID attached to the case.

functions.name: get_basket_evidence
functions.description: Read basket RSSI, zone, active sessions, and event metadata for the shelf event.

eventId.description: Shelf event ID attached to the case.

functions.name: get_cart_history
functions.description: Read current basket carts, sessions, recent orders, and case resolutions.

functions.name: get_signal_window
functions.description: Read bounded telemetry RSSI samples around the source event, including timing provenance.

functions.name: get_device_health
functions.description: Inspect heartbeat age, reboot, queue backlog and dropped-event evidence.

functions.name: get_lane_state
functions.description: Read independently reported switch presence near the source event.

functions.name: get_event_neighbors
functions.description: Inspect same-lane events around the source event for rapid transitions.

functions.name: get_camera_evidence
functions.description: Read reported camera observations. May return NO_DATA; does not capture RTSP or run vision.

functions.name: run_evidence_analysis
functions.description: Run an allowlisted read-only script: rssi_stability, switch_bounce or cart_consistency.
